scripts.prerelease: git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: release prep'
scripts.release-patch: npm run prerelease && npm version patch && npm run build && npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release-minor: npm run prerelease && npm version minor && npm run build && npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org && git push && git push --tags
scripts.release-major: npm run prerelease && npm version major && npm run build && npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org && git push && git push --tags
